title: Beacon Hill Children's Farm
specs: Visitors must feel healthy to visit
Children must be accompanied and actively supervised by an adult
Volunteers minimum age 7 years, under 14 must be accompanied by adult
Groups of 10 or more must book in advance
Recommended adult to child ratio: 1:6 for children, 1:10 for youth

options.name: Group Visits
options.detail: Group visits require advance booking with recommended early booking in April or May

variants.label: Group visits require advance booking with recommended early booking in April or May

includes: Access to pet and interact with farm animals
Use of handwashing stations with soap and water
blurb: Visitors can interact with various farm animals including goats, pigs, miniature donkeys, guinea pigs, alpacas, ducks, chickens, budgies, a conure, finches, doves, and a farm cat. The farm features a goat petting area with specific rules to ensure safety and comfort for animals and visitors. Group visits require advance booking and follow specific supervision and behavior guidelines.
extraNote: No advance booking for small groups; large groups (10+) must book in advance · Cancellation requires 48 hours notice for group visits · Open rain or shine except severe inclement weather · Maximum capacity limits in goat petting area on busy days · April through October
